data.text:
M/S Amartex Industries Ltd vs Food Safety Officer on 11 
September, 2024 
 1
 In The High Court Of Himachal Pradesh, Shimla
 .
 Civil Revision No.57 of 2022 
 Date of Decision : 11.09.2024 
 M/s Amartex Industries Ltd.
 ...... Petitioner
 Versus
 Food Safety Officer, Mandi and another 
 ......Respondents  Coram:
 The Hon'ble Mr. Justice Bipin Chander Negi, Judge  Whether approved for reporting?1  For the petitioner : None for the petitioner. 
 For the respondents : Mr. Gautam Sood, Deputy Advocate General, for  respondent No.1. 
 Respondent No.2 proceeded ex parte vide order M/S Amartex Industries Ltd vs Food Safety Officer on 11 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/103115061/
1  dated 18.07.2022.
 Bipin Chander Negi, Judge (oral)
Despite repeated calls , there is no appearance on behalf of the petitioner. Even, on the last date of hearing, there was no appearance on behalf of the petitioner. 
2. In the case at hand, impugned order dated 04.01.2022 is an order, whereby, an application under Section 5 of the Limitation Act, has been dismissed. Against the said impugned order, a revision has been preferred. The maintainability of the same is highly doubtful, as prima facie, an appeal ought to have been preferred. 
Whether reporters of Local Papers may be allowed to see the judgment? Yes 3. In view thereof and the fact that none has put in appearance on behalf of the petitioner, present matter is dismissed for .
non prosecution. 
4. Pending miscellaneous application(s), if any, shall also stand disposed of.
 ( Bipin Chander Negi)
 September 11, 2024 (KS) Judge M/S Amartex Industries Ltd vs Food Safety Officer on 11 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/103115061/
